dimensions.summary: Every terminal Agent knowledge path settles one strict reference-only outcome in the same durable Job transition.
Job schema, contracts, renderer events, Activity History, Playbook and acceptance share one outcome vocabulary.
E3.07 and PIGE-KNOW-006 are verified by executable created, updated, linked, skipped, failed and needs-attention evidence.
A bounded outcome owner leaves mutation services unchanged while retry clears stale terminal facts before new work.
Existing Job and Playbook owners already define the behavior, so no new design document or duplicate status surface is introduced.

verification.evidence: All six outcomes retain bounded fields, citations, writes, Operations, Undo and recovery references across exact Job settlement.

verification.command: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run verify:architecture-reset
verification.evidence: The outcome candidate compiles and builds while Jobs remains below its frozen architecture budget and the new owner is inventory-bound.
